tools.name: kledo_list_invoices
tools.description: List sales invoices with contact, dates, amounts and status. Supports due-date and amount filters. Kledo API: GET /finance/invoices.

tools.name: kledo_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one sales invoice with its line items, payments and contact. Kledo API: GET /finance/invoices/{id}.

tools.name: kledo_list_quotes
tools.description: List sales quotes (penawaran). Kledo API: GET /finance/quotes.

tools.name: kledo_list_sales_orders
tools.description: List sales orders. Kledo API: GET /finance/orders.

tools.name: kledo_list_purchase_invoices
tools.description: List purchase invoices (vendor bills) with amounts and status. Kledo API: GET /finance/purchaseInvoices.

tools.name: kledo_get_purchase_invoice
tools.description: Get one purchase invoice with its line items. Kledo API: GET /finance/purchaseInvoices/{id}.

tools.name: kledo_list_expenses
tools.description: List recorded expenses (biaya). Kledo API: GET /finance/expenses.

tools.name: kledo_list_contacts
tools.description: List customers, vendors and other contacts with receivable/payable totals when requested. Kledo API: GET /finance/contacts.

tools.name: kledo_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact with address, phone, email and (optionally) stats. Kledo API: GET /finance/contacts/{id}.

tools.name: kledo_list_products
tools.description: List products and services with prices; optionally with stock per warehouse. Kledo API: GET /finance/products.

tools.name: kledo_get_product
tools.description: Get one product or service with prices and settings. Kledo API: GET /finance/products/{id}.

tools.name: kledo_list_accounts
tools.description: List accounts of the chart of accounts, optionally with balances. Kledo API: GET /finance/accounts.

tools.name: kledo_get_bank_balances
tools.description: Get the balance of every cash and bank account. Kledo API: GET /finance/bank/balances.

tools.name: kledo_list_bank_transactions
tools.description: List bank transactions (money in, money out, transfers). Kledo API: GET /finance/bankTrans.

tools.name: kledo_report_profit_loss
tools.description: Profit and loss (laba rugi) for a period. Kledo API: GET /reportings/profitLoss.

tools.name: kledo_report_balance_sheet
tools.description: Balance sheet (neraca) as of a date. Kledo API: GET /reportings/balanceSheet.

tools.name: kledo_report_trial_balance
tools.description: Trial balance for a period. Kledo API: GET /reportings/trialBalance.

tools.name: kledo_report_cash_flow
tools.description: Cash flow statement for a period (direct or indirect method). Kledo API: GET /reportings/cashFlow.

tools.name: kledo_report_aged_receivable
tools.description: Unpaid customer invoices grouped by age. Kledo API: GET /reportings/agedReceivable.

tools.name: kledo_report_aged_payable
tools.description: Unpaid vendor bills grouped by age. Kledo API: GET /reportings/agedPayable.

tools.name: kledo_report_executive_summary
tools.description: Executive summary (revenue, cost, cash, receivables) for a month. Kledo API: GET /reportings/executiveSummary.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: kledo_get_contact · Private data: kledo_list_invoices, kledo_get_invoice, kledo_list_contacts, kledo_get_contact · Public sink: kledo_get_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: kledo_get_contact · Private data: kledo_list_invoices, kledo_get_invoice, kledo_list_contacts, kledo_get_contact · Public sink: kledo_get_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
